We are thrilled to announce the kickstarter launch of REIGNMAKER 2!

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/frogdice/reignmaker-2-not-your-fathers-match-3

ReignMaker 2 is a match 3, tower defense, city building, and strategy game. It will put your reflexes, cleverness, pattern recognition, and strategy to the test. 

ReignMaker 2 continues the world story right where Stash leaves off with the exploits of all you adventurers!


Peace reigned and civilization flourished throughout the three kingdoms of Askagard, Troj, and Chemer. But peace brings complacency, and adventurers got curious, bored, and greedy. Looking for wealth and treasure, they unearthed and explored the ruins, caves, mines, and despoiled temples across Primordiax. Deep they delved into these many dungeons... too deep. They disturbed the Avatars of the Void you had imprisoned and buried in the earth. 


We would hugely appreciate your support in our campaign. The more help we get and the sooner we get it, the better we perform in kickstarter search algorithms and thus more people will see it!

notes.title: 2018.05.03 - UI Overhaul. Crafting Skill Enhancements. More Mobs in World Dungeons.

BOO, Stash, and Market Stalls

 Fixed a bug where the medallion icon was displayed twice in the Boo Upgrade confirmation popup.
 Deleted characters no longer show up in BOO invite lists.


Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Added level next to character name in the character inspector window.


Chat and UI

 UI Updates have been made for the following elements:

	 Manage Boo Room
	 Boo Change Door/Layout/Wall/Floor
	 Add Room (Boo)
	 Social Window
	 Player Info / Portrait (Top right HUD)
	 Party Portraits (Left HUD)
	 System Menu
	 Login
	 Leaderboard Rewards

 Fixed a bug where returning to the login screen after a disconnect met with the UI being non interactable.



Crafting

 Crafting skill level now has a significant impact on crafting speed. For every 1 point of skill the player has over the level of the item, speed bonus is 1% (up to a maximum of 20%).
 The Quality % roll is now more significantly impacted by your Charisma stat and your skill level. Getting those 95-100% quality items should require a little more CHA and skill.
 Level 30 Minor Rejeuvenation Potion fixed.


Dungeons

 Significant increases in the monster density of many World Dungeons. Approximate increases:

	 The Mines - 10%

	 Fungeon Caves - 50%
	 Ruined Barracks - 25%
	 D'Orc Den - 20%

 Added "Recipes" and "Furniture" to the dropdown filters in your Inventory and Stash windows.

Misc

notes.title: Tier 4 Expansion! New Armor Cosmetic System. Tons of Ability, UI, and Misc Improvements.
notes.content:
Tier 4 Has Launched - Level and Skill Cap is now 40


All class abilities now go up to level 40.

All crafts can be advanced to level 40.

Mounts can be found on the medallion shop that allow passage into new regions.

New private and world dungeons added (with new bosses!).

Have fun!


New Armor Cosmetic System


Your character's armor cosmetic appearance is now completely controlled by the costume tab and not by your functional/gear armor. We have separated these two things completely to make it easier for you to customize your appearance and to support future plans for a wide variety of cosmetic options that would have created confusing conflicts otherwise. 


Weapons and offhands perform the same as before as far as visual appearance. Visually you appear with your actual wielded weapons/offhands/shields unless you override that with a costume option. 


All costume items you had equipped on any costume pages have been removed and sent to your reward inventory.


All cosmetic shoulders, arms/gloves, and boot items no longer exist. All of these cosmetic slots are controlled through the body/suit piece and then toggling/selecting which additional slots to display. 


Cosmetic armor is now controlled through two pieces: helmet and body (which controls all the other body locations). 


https://i.imgur.com/c4ld5Jw.png

Other Patch Notes:

BOO, Stash, and Market Stalls

 Bug Fix: Players can now rename their stall and place ads from anywhere in their BOO
 Item tooltips in the npc vendor, stall, and newspaper UIs now show comparisons to what you have currently equipped.
 Added tooltips for farmhands to producers.
 Updated/Added tooltips for when farmhand helping is on cooldown and for when the producer (total possible help) is on cooldown.
 Added client chat messages for successful help actions, for both boo owner and farmhand.
 Fixed a bug where dragging items from your Stash into your inventory with a bag selected, didn't add them to THAT bag.
 Max stash size increased by +10.


Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Resurrection is now fully supported and returns you to the combat.
	
	 Rez now adds characters back into combat.
	
 Fixed an issue with animations freezing after playing.
 Added a sound effect for when you block in combat.
 Ability buffs are downranked to the lower rank version when used on characters whose level is lower than the casted ability level (to a minimum of Rank I).
 Warrior:
	
	 Cut II - DoT tick duration increased by 1 round
	 Cut III - DoT tick duration increased by 2 rounds
	
 Hunter:
	
	 Slash now does +10% damage on foes with a combo point.
	 Flaming Arrow II - DoT tick increased by 1 round
	
 Healer:
	
	 Spread Heal healing increased by 10%.
	 Healing Pulse now ticks significantly longer.
	
 Ability tooltips now include the Element of the ability.
 Added multi-target support to the Effects Manager. AoE abilities like Mass Mez, Root, etc. should now play effects on all affected targets.


Chat and UI

 Fixed a bug where you could drag the stat progress bars in the character stats window.
 Added a chat log entry for weapon proc damage.
 You can once again chat during the loot event.


Combat

 Bug Fix: Players should no longer spawn into objects when encounter formations are utilized
 Converted the Death Popup to new UI code and made necessary adjustments.
 Weapon procs print to combat log.
 Some small obstacles may now be walked over/through.
 Healing Pulse now blocks its grid square.


Crafting

 Recipe tooltips now tell you if you already know the recipe.
 Added a toast message for when you receive any trade skill xp.



Dungeons

 Fixed an issue causing bosses to display busy when dying to them and exiting the encounter.



Gear and Items

 Character armor appearance now controlled completely by costume slots, not gear armor slots.
 Platemail is now in the game. Warriors can wear it starting at level 30.
 Ringmail is now in the game. Hunters can wear it starting at level 30.
 Healers can now wear chainmail starting at level 30.
 If there is a cooldown returned for an unsuccessful item use, the time remaining is now displayed in the error popup. (currently does not *tick* down)
 Added level to costume tooltips.
 Fixed an issue with body parts not getting disabled under costumes.


Graphical

 Fixed lighting issues in the Rolling Stone Inn.
 Fixed an issue with character's hands still gripping their weapons even when the weapons are hidden.
 Fixed an issue with missing hands for all chainmail and trulloc/human male elementalists.
 Fixed an issue having to do with invisible hands for HM hunters.


Medallion Shop

 Fixed an issue where weapons/offhands didn't show up when previewing from the medallion shop in the new armor system.


Mobs and NPCs

 Cubes, due to their gelatinous bodies, are now properly more resistant to physical attacks.


Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Added shift+click support for multi-purchases from the clan shop.



Misc

 Updated Mob Spread / Add Algorithm
 Add new round info sent to client when a new combat round starts
 Turn check made for resource harvesting in combat
 When learning a higher level ability, the lesser level ability is no longer "relearned"
 When learning replacement skills, the 'old skill' is now removed from all bars it was applied to.
 Camping upon immediately entering a zone no longer spits players out of the zone upone camp exit.
 Status FX are now properly removed upon exit of combat (including by death).
 Updated help window texts in Combat Victory and Character Sheet - Inventory.
 Added a new help window called Armor, Gear, & Cosmetics. This window automatically pops up the first time you equip a piece of gear.

notes.title: 2018.01.26 - Bigger, Badder, Boss Battles, New Alchemy potions, More XP for harder mobs
notes.content:
Official Forum Thread:
http://forums.frogdice.com/showthread.php/9283-2018.01.26-Bigger-Badder-Boss-Battles-New-Alchemy-potions-More-XP-for-harder-mobs

BOO, Stash, and Market Stalls

 Bug Fix: Items can now be listed on your Stash Stall from anywhere in your boo
 Fixed a bug causing the stall upgrade window to always show you as having zero triads.
 Item tooltips in the npc vendor, stall, and newspaper UIs now show comparisons to what you have currently equipped.


Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Healer resistance buffs' magnitude reduced to comply with resist cap rules. Previously, these buffs were so overtuned that by themselves they capped people's resists. This made all resist enchants or other resist related abilities, items, or potions moot.
 Healer: Healing pulse duration increased from 2 rounds to 8 rounds. Area of Effect changed to 2 square radius.
 Warrior Taunt & Intimidate: -dmg/-str debuff increased
 Bolster: duration increased from 5 to 7 rounds.
 Hunter: elemental arrows (flaming, frozen, charged, concussive) now do 10% more damage against mobs with at least 1 combo point.
 Fixed a bug that allowed characters to float away off their pegs visually.



Combat

 Bug Fix: Players should no longer spawn into objects when encounter formations are utilized
 Fixed a bug where holding the mouse down during the "Your Turn" animation, would keep the text on screen until you released the mouse button.


Crafting

 Alchemy: Health potions heal amount increased by ~66% (two-thirds).
 Alchemy: resist fire, water, air, and earth potions added. 
 Fixed a bug where the crafting machine didn't update the last crafted recipe without having to close and reopen the machine.



Dungeons

 Some dungeons had their mob spawn types adjusted.



Gear and Items

 Bug Fix: Right Click->Equip on gathering tools in Costume Tab no longer improperly equips tool
 Fixed an error in the calculation for damage in bow tooltips.



Graphical

 Fixed lighting issues in the Rolling Stone Inn.


Medallion Shop

 Added Shift+Click support for bulk purchasing from the Medallion shop. (Note: Clan shop will get the same functionality in the near future.)


Mobs and NPCs

 Bosses now commonly have adds and multiple phases to their fights. Boss Battles just got a whole lot more interesting (and dangerous, and rewarding).
 Harder Mobs are now more rewarding!
	
	 Healer type mobs are worth more XP (base 150).
	 High DPS/AoE mobs are also worth more XP (base 125)
	 Previously all mobs had a base XP value of 100, modified by con and rank.
	
 Added missing timeouts to boss abilities.
 New Mob Type: Noxious Void. Be on the lookout for this new type of Void creature.



World

 You can now click on Askagard to path to the entrance.

notes.content:
Combat

 Mob Squads: Specialized teams of mobs that have different roles and AIs to make them a more interesting and challenging adversary.

		 This squad works together by sending the regular Gobbos to engage in melee, Bombadiers providing ranged support, and Shamans to heal everyone.
		
 Fixed timing issues with certain mob animations / effects.
 Fixed an issue with player hit animations.
 Fixed a bug where brace-killing a mob didn't remove them from the turn queue.


Mobs and NPCs

 Ranked Mobs (lieutenants, elites, and champions) now have special loot tables so their drops can be different (better) than normal versions. Mob types whose ranked versions have significantly increased loot drops include:
	
	 Beasts
	 Elementals
	 Humanoids
	 Gobbo Bombadiers
	 Gobbo Healers
	 Slimes
	 Fungoids
	 Undead
	 Skeleton Healers
	 Void
	 Flying
	 Dragons
	

 XP Rewards are now based on level difference (party level vs. mob level) rathern than con color. Party level is the level of the highest level person in a party.
	
	 Level Difference (Mob Level - Party Level)
		
		 -5 = 0% xp
		 -4 = 20% xp
		 -3 = 40% xp
		 -2 = 60% xp
		 -1 = 80% xp
		  0 = 100% xp
		  1 = 125% xp
		  2 = 150% xp
		  3 = 175% xp
		  4 = 200% xp
		  5 = 225% xp

notes.title: 2017.12.11 - Medallions x100, Rolling Stone Inn, Mob CC, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This is a small but very significant patch due to the x100 of Medallions.

Medallion Changes - x100!

 All accounts had their current medallion totals multiplied by 100.

 All medallion costs for things in game were multiplied by 100.

 The absolute effect of this is no change for players, but it gives us the ability to have things that cost smaller amounts of medallions than what previously would have been 1 medallion. It also gives us the ability to give away medallions as rewards for more things, since we can do so in smaller denominations now.


Bug Fixes:

 Issues loading into the Rolling Stone Inn have been fixed.

 The Newspaper now clears the data on which stalls you have visited each time you close the newspaper.

 Parties no longer follow their leaders into trap encounters.

 Rezzing at the BOO no longer places your character at its last location if you immediately do a character change after rez.

 Fixed a bug that would on rare occasions result in a Mob not being CCed when it should.

 Mobs that are CCed now explicity skip their turn (you will see it in the combat log). So you can more easily verify they are properly staying CCed when they should.

notes.title: This Weekend on Stash: Shards of Primordium monster grinding competition!
notes.content:
This Weekend on Stash (Friday, Oct 20 - Monday, Oct 23)
 
Shards of Primordium monster grinding competition!

 +10% to all XP earned from monsters.
 Every monster in the game has a chance to drop a Shard of Primordium.

For those who played Stash at launch: we completed numerous code and hardware upgrades that fixed all known performance issues some people experienced. Jump back in and have a blast!
 
Other new features and improvements over the last month:

 Tons of new abilities added to every class. 
 12 new dungeons.
 Numerous enhancements and quality of life improvements to the newspaper and market system. 
 Gathering in the overworld scans your inventory for the needed tool so you don't have to switch it manually.
 Improvements to crafting, trapping, fishing, and farming.

 Chat UI and other social improvements.

 Bug fixes galore.


As excited as we are about all the new content and improvements, we are most proud of the amazing community in Stash. We are so fortunate to have such fun, helpful, interesting, and hilarious people in our community. Thank you!
 
More details about this event, links to the new player guide, links to our very active discord server, links to other October events (like Halloween weekend), and more can be found here:
 
http://forums.frogdice.com/showthread.php/9170-Shards-of-Primordium-Weekend-Event
 
This weekend is going to be a blast. We hope to see you in game!

notes.title: New class abilities, Farming & Trapping improvements, NPC Vendor Fix
notes.content:
Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Warrior:

 Slam now does bonus damage on targets with at least 1 combo point.
 Guard II added at level 14.
 Slam II added at level 16.
 Fortitude II added at level 22.
 Cut III added at level 23.
 Cleave 2 added at level 24.


 Elementalist:

	 All tier 1 elementalist spells now have a 100% chance (from 70%) to apply their combo condition (ignite, stagger, shock, chill).
	
	 Water Spells:
		
		 Frost Breath I (AoE) moved from level 12 to level 8, giving elementalists their first AoE 4 levels earlier.
		 Cryobeam I (tier 3) moved from level 9 to 11.
		 Ice Blast II (tier 1) added at level 16.
		
	
	 Fire Spells:
		
		 Bloodboil I (tier 3) moved from level 11 to 10.
		
	
	 Air Spells:
		
		 Shockwave I (AoE) moved from level 14 to 13.
		 Charged Bolt I (tier 2) moved from level 5 to 7.
		 Thunderstrike I (tier 3) moved from level 10 to 15.
		 Zap II (tier 1) added at level 17.
		
	
	 Earth Spells:
		
		 Pelt (tier 1) moved from level 4 to 9.
		 Vine Whip (tier 2) moved from level 7 to 12.
		 Hurl Boulder (tier 3) moved from level 8 to 14.
		 Thorn Burst (AoE) moved from level 16 to 21.
		 Pelt II (tier 1) added at level 19.
		


 Hunter:

 Slash II added at level 13
 Flaming Arrow II added at level 15 with 100% chance to apply ignite combo effect.
 Distract moved from level 18 to level 15.
 Frozen Arrow I now applies a -1 snare (movement reduction) for 1 round.
 Frozen Arrow II added at level 17 (applies a -1 snare for 2 rounds).
 Balestra II added at level 18.
 Vanish II added at level 21.


 Healer:

 Smite cooldown increased.


 Replaced Lajena's teeth with small, wooden dowels.


Farming / Trapping

 Fixed a bug where producers didn't display the number of days remaining in the tooltips.
 The error popup for when a producer is full now displays the machine name instead of the producer type.
 Fixed a bug where placing a trap removed access to the remaining traps in that stack, until you opened your inventory to refresh the data from the server.
 Fish trapping bug fixed (should be able to catch fish now!).



Chat and UI

 Fixed a bug causing the chat window to send messages when the window got defocused without the player pressing enter.
 Fixed a bug causing the character limit on chat to not get enforced.
 Fixed an issue with rounding health/mana for tooltips.



Combat

 Fixed a bug causing mobs to stop moving after a braced attacked damages them, without casting the finishing blow, when they should have continued along their path.



Crafting

 Fixed a bug where removing a deconstructing item didn't start the countdown for the next item in the queue.
 Fixed a bug having to do with discarding recipes.



Gear and Items

 Fixed a bug where moving a stackable item from one bag to another didn't remove the item from the original bag if it updated a stack in the new bag.



Mobs and NPCs

 NPCs no longer buy back items for 100% value. This was never intended for obvious reasons (and non obvious ones also, like people using this to effectively "rent" expensive items for free).



Misc

 Fixed a bug where attempting to trade with someone after previously offering to trade, but leaving the area before they could respond, would stop you from being able to offer them another one until you relogged.
 AFK timeout increased to 2 hours.

notes.title: 2017.10.12 - 12 New Dungeons, More Newspaper Improvements, Tons of QoL and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Dungeons

 12 new Tier 3 (20-29) Dungeons (RPDs) of 3 distinct types implemented in multiple regions.
 New RPD graphics added to existing RPDs.



Market & Newspaper

 Adds older than 1 week expire.
 Newspapers now "chunk then filter" rather than "filter then chunk" which will make every newspaper have a lot more ads.
 Fixed a bug that did not display an error when you've reached the max number of favorited stalls.
 Newspaper ad stall names now shrink to fit.



Base of Operations

 Removed brick cost and added plank cost to BOO Room Layout change.
 Fixed BOO furniture and upgrades not appearing/refreshing properly.
 Fixed a bug where opening the upgrade Stash popup and then closing it caused the max Stash size to be asymptotic.
 Fixed a bug where stash / shared stash capacity values did not change if viewing a filter not matching an item added.
 Fixed colliders on the level 22 Boo.



Farming / Trapping

 Fixed a tooltip issue when quickly moving the mouse between producers.



Chat and UI

 Fixed a bug where selecting the tell channel via button after talking in another channel made the chat window forget who the last tell was sent to.
 Fixed a bug where creating a new tab displayed all of the chat text without senders.
 Fixed a bug where pressing enter closed the tab options and didn't save/update the settings.



Combat

 Fixed a bug with charge 2.
 Mobs should no longer spawn off-combat grid ( very visible in L shaped encounters)
 Fixed a bug where status effects causing you to not be able to flee combat weren't displaying correctly in error popups.
 Fixed the loot received grab n go chat message display.



Crafting

 Fixed a popup error message when attempting to add an item to a deconstructor that is at maximum capacity.
 Fixed the scroll bar in the recipe book.
 Fixed T2 leather armor to require T2 resources instead of T1 resources



Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Customization/costume changes update to viewers immediately upon character sheet close
 Cleave fixed to properly hit adjacent mobs only, where adjacent is defined as "to the left, right, above, or below" the target (diagonal no longer considered as "next to" target)
 Healer AoE CCs area of effect reduced.
 Lion Kick cooldown reduced.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Upon selecting "Send Tell" in the Social window, the window now closes as to not block the chat window.
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't inspect characters from chat if they weren't in the area.
 Character portraits are no longer retaken when the party status is updated.
 Fixed a bug causing the full difficulty list to not display in the party window.
 Increased the maximum clan rank name length to 13 (from 8) characters.



Gear and Items

 You can now drop reward items on bag slots.
 Buff potion durations increased from 1800 to 3600.
 Fixed several BOO items and machines to take up the correct amount of space when placed



Mobs and NPCs

 Bug fixed that caused mobs to sometimes spawn off the grid.


 
World

 Fixed a bug causing mobs to spawn in hills.



Medallion Shop

 Fixed a bug causing item previews in the medallion shop to not work	



Misc

 General improvements to reduce memory use and increase performance.
 Fixed a couple bugs with character portraits solo and in parties.

notes.title: Advisors & Advisor Applications
notes.content:
What is an Advisor?

Advisors are dedicated player volunteers who help promote, support, and preserve a positive community on Stash.

They have multiple roles:

 Moderators: They have various moderation tools available to them to moderate chat and help make sure channels and the community stay positive and non-toxic.

 Community Organizers: They organize and run events that engage the the community in creative and fun ways. They also participate in chat to keep things active so players feel comfortable jumping in.

 New Player Helpers: They help new players get acclimated to the game and figure things out.


While all Advisors do a bit of all 3 of the above things, individual Advisors may specialize in certain aspects more than others depending on their personal skill sets and level of comfort.

Read more details about Advisors and how to apply in the official forum thread:

http://forums.frogdice.com/showthread.php/9155-Advisors-amp-Advisor-Applications

notes.title: 2017.09.28 - More High Rank mobs in groups, AoE balancing, Looking for Group Channel
notes.content:
Mobs and NPCs

 Previous HP scaling buff to mobs was reverted/removed.
 Lieutenants, Elites, and Champions now have higher stats and more health.
 Lieutenants, Elites, and Champions are now worth significantly more XP. 
 Parties have a higher chance of encountering Lieutenants, Elites, Champions, and Bosses.



Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Combat has become a bit too dominated by AoE. As a first small step towards balancing that, we have made two small adjustments:

	 Every AoE ability in the game received a 10% damage reduction.
	 Nearly every AoE ability in the game had its cooldown increased by 1 or 2 rounds.




Gear and Items

 Fixed a bug where food that required a higher level that yours did not display in italics.
 Shields should now properly display their block chance in tooltip.



Base of Operations

 Fixed a bug where changing a Boo interior room layout caused the placed items to disappear until you left and re-entered the room.
 Fixed a clipping issue with small beds.



Chat and UI

 Fixed tells.
 Fixed emotes for all other channels.
 Fixed context menus of characters for new channels.
 OOC channel tag now all caps.
 Fixed a bug where pressing Enter at the same time as the last letter typed in chat would fire the the keybinding for that letter (if any).
 Fixed /r sometimes changing who you're replying to.
 Improved the Channel Indicator button text for a better idea of the current channel.
 The name of the current tell now appears as a tooltip over the Channel Indicator button and the Tell button in the Indicator selection popup.
 Added the Looking for Group (LFG) chat channel.
 Fixed a bug where the context menu for characters in chat would go off the bottom of the screen.



Combat

 Fixed major issue where certain combat scenarios spawned mobs outside of expected places



Market & Newspaper

 Fixed a bug where viewed stalls' ads on separate pages did not highlight.
 Newspapers are now in alphabetical order in the dropdown.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Party max size more stringently enforced at server level



World

 When characters close their window after changing gear, customization options, costumes, etc, all other characters in the area now see this update.

	

Medallion Shop

 Lemon Cookies of Mortis: Removes XP debt up to 10% of the XP needed for your next level. (1 death worth of debt at level 20+)
 Hearth Beacon: resets your Hearth Beacon ability cooldown.
 Summoning Stone: empowers the party summon ability accessible via the party meny (press: p)

notes.title: 2017.09.22 - Alchemy buffs, Newspaper, Clans, Abilities, and Crafting
notes.content:
WEEKEND EVENT - 9/22 (Fri) to 9/25 (Mon)

 +10% to all experience (combat, crafting, and gathering)
 +50% more resource nodes in all major world regions.



SWIFTOR STREAM ON TWITCH!

Stash will be streamed on Twitch Friday, September 22 at 9pm EDT, by a rather large twitch channel: Swiftor!  https://www.twitch.tv/swiftor

========================================

Action Bar / Loader

 Fixed a bug where spamming buttons on the Boo Actionbar caused errors to occur.



Base of Operations

 Fixed a bug where viewing someone's stall while visiting their BOO would subsequently make your own stall appear empty to you.
 Fixed a bug affecting processors that were placed in rooms other than the main entryway.
 Fixed a bug where processors had no tooltip when placed in the Boo.



Chat and UI

 The Interfaces menu now loads sooner so it opens more rapidly.
 Added a link to Carazan's guide to the Help Index, as well as updated the links section.
 The new Medallion graphic should be everywhere now.
 Added Triads tooltip to player inventory.
 Fixed a potential exploit with the trade command.



Combat

 Flanking now properly factored in for players who started their round not flanking but move into flanking position before attacking.
 Fixed a bug where action bar buttons were not getting disabled to reflect status effects.




Crafting

 Alchemy: stat buff potions got a significant boost. Tier 1 increased +100% and Tier 2 increased +33%.
 Fixed a bug where enchanted gear didn't show up in deconstructors that weren't the disenchanter.
 Fixed a bug where the client didn't think items with the suffix "the ____" were worthy of being considered enchanted.
 Fixed an issue with processors not outputting exactly the right amount.
 Fixed the disenchant output for prefixes and suffixes (swapped them).
 Alchemy, Enchanting, and Maker recipes that dropped on the x5 levels but had the same output as their x0 versions of the same tier should no longer drop. You can safely forget those recipes.
 Offhand items can now be deconstructed only in the Deweaponizer.



Market & Newspaper

 Increased number of ads in a paper from 240 to 360.
 A new newspaper is generated every 5 minutes instead of 10.
 Added "New Paper" time to the Newspaper.
 Fixed a bug where you could spam page turns in the Newspaper to get more ads on a page than you should.
 Filter button removed from newspaper. Two additional newspapers will be added in the future that do a better job than this button whose function was non-obvious and many people were unaware of.



Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 Ice Knife - now properly does damage when it applies CC (root).
 Willpower buff now properly grants +20 mana in addition to +WILL.
 Elementalist tier 1 spells now have more detail in their descriptions to clarify what the ignited, chilled, shocked, and staggered conditions mean.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Clans: You can now kick/promote/demote members even when they are offline.
 Added invite submit button to clan window.



Gear and Items

 Offhand cosmetic items work properly now.
 Fixed a bug where double-clicking and then immediately dragging an item caused the resulting icon to get stuck on the screen.
 Fixed a bug where cosmetic weapons didn't display on offwielded weapons.
 Fixed magic offhand tooltips.



Mobs and NPCs

 Mob rank boost now dependent upon number of players in an encounter, not party. (Should end LDP finally!)



World

 Characters arrive in communal encounters (e.g. Rolling Stone Inn) at a random spot rather than right at the entrance.
 Fixed bug that would occasionally cause some PoIs (like Askagard) to not load properly (though you could still trigger them by walking onto them).



Medallion Shop

 Medallion graphic updated.



Misc

 Fixed a bug where objects that didn't have a BoxCollider on them (ie, had a MeshCollider) didn't show a tooltip.

notes.title: 2017.09.15 - World Map Auto Tool "Swap", No more LDPs, Weekend Events!
notes.content:
Event to Celebrate Launch Week

 +10% to all XP (combat, crafting, and gathering) from Friday, 9/15 until Monday morning, 9/18 


 Social Meet & Greet: 7-9 pm EDT, Saturday 9/16. Gather together on Stash to meet developers, talk about the game, and meet other players. There will be Q&A and random prize drawings. Push the server to the max in preparation for a big twitch stream next week.



========================================

Featured Changes:

Gathering

 On the World Map, gathering in resource nodes now scans inventory for gathering tool. Combat is unchanged (you still need to make a choice about which tools to equip for combat harvesting).



Base of Operations

 Fixed a bug where removing an item from your Stash with exactly 1 open spot in a bag, would cause the client to claim all bags full.
 Added tooltips to the resource bar in the Boo.



Crafting

 Farming XP properly multiples the XP amount by the stack size of the item removed. This was previously broken on PROCESSORS.


Combat

 Encounter size is now based on number of players in the encounter, not number of players in a party. So if a party splits up they only get scaled up battles based on the players in the actual battle.
 Delay no longer resets your movement counter so you can move again. (HUGE exploit. Please report if this is still exploitable.)
 Fixed issue with pinned/flanking where ranged attackers were showing as pinned/flanking when they really were not.


========================================

All Changes (including above):

Base of Operations

 Changed the error popup for waiting to place another ad to display the correct, updated wait time.
 Updated the actionbar tooltips for visiting other BOOs.
 Fixed a bug where the client wasn't checking to see if the user was already at max rooms before adding a new room.
 Fixed a bug where removing an item from your Stash with exactly 1 open spot in a bag, would cause the client to claim all bags full.
 Added tooltips to the resource bar in the Boo.



Combat

 Encounter size is now based on number of players in the encounter, not number of players in a party. So if a party splits up they only get scaled up battles based on the players in the actual battle.
 Delay no longer resets your movement counter so you can move again. (HUGE exploit. Please report if this is still exploitable.)
 Fixed issue with pinned/flanking where ranged attackers were showing as pinned/flanking when they really were not.



Crafting

 Fixed a bug where tool, consumable, and machine recipe tooltips weren't displaying the correct recipe information.
 Farming XP properly multiples the XP amount by the stack size of the item removed. This was previously broken on PROCESSORS.
 Harvesting trees now properly gives wood.
 Newspaper

 each unique newspaper now has 240 ads. Your personal newspaper resets every 10 minutes.
 Free newspaper ad can be placed every 10 minutes now rather than 5 minutes. This is  now caps newspaper output at 240 ads.
 The Newspaper will be receiving constant work over the next few weeks to continue streamlining its use (but it will never have a full search feature as that is not its purpose).




Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Changed clan create dialogue to say 10,000 triad instead of 100.



Gear and Items

 In the tooltip, not being able to wield an item due to class is now prioritised and ignores level if this is the case.
 Stacking fix: quality now properly set when items are split (or any other time item A is created based on item B; item A's quality will be set to that of item B).



Gathering

 On the World Map, gathering in resource nodes now scans inventory for gathering tool. Combat is unchanged (you still need to make a choice about which tools to equip for combat harvesting).

notes.content:

notes.title: UPDATE: 2017/06/23 - Elementalist and Gathering buffs, tons of fixes and UI improvements
notes.content:
A lot of good stuff in this update!

Characters, Classes, and Abilities

 ːrpokkaː Elementalist ːrpokkaː 
 All tier 1 spells (Fire Blast, Zap, Ice Blast, and Pelt) had their range increased from 4 to 5.
 Ice Knife (tier 2 water spell) has a different bonus effect when used on a foe that is chilled. Instead of additional damage, it will root the foe for 2-3 rounds. Chill can be applied with Ice Blast or Hunter's Frost Arrow. 



Gathering

 You will receive an additional +1 resource when harvesting a node in combat while there are mobs still alive.



Mobs and NPCs

 Mobs lose their low level damage output reduction more gradually. Previously, mobs level 1-10 had their damage reduced by 50%, and returned to normal at 11. Now the damage reduction is gradually removed from 11-15 (40%, 30%, 20%, 10%, then normal damage at 15).



World

 Improved the functionality of Click-to-Move, enabling a smoother experience.
 Fixed a significant performance drop that would worsen the longer you ran the client in the open world.



Chat and UI

 New error popup messages for failed logins.
 Fixed a bug causing the chat window to not show the color wheel for selecting text colors.
 Fixed a bug where you could not reorder tabs (and have them save).
 Fixed an issue causing double chat logs when chat messages come in while zoning.
 Fixed a bug where multiple camp materials would stack in the camp window the first time you dropped down the category.
 The tooltip for the xp bar now rounds down so that no one is confused about the percent reaching 100 when they still have some experience to go (mostly seen at higher levels).



BOO, Stash, and Market Stalls

 Fixed a bug where double-clicking a sold item in your Stall didn't collect it.



Social (Clans, Parties, Religions, etc.)

 Clans: Fixed a bug where Promote and Demote didn't do anything.



Gear and Items

 Fixed a but where swapping bags updated the bags but not the inventory displayed.
 Fixed a bug where replacing a bag displayed the new bag in a different slot that it actually was.
 The popup to split an item stack now selects one of the inputs immediately and pressing enter will finalize the action.
 Food and Potion tooltips now have Quality.



Settings

 Fixed a bug where a number of settings weren't getting saved on exit.



Misc

 Moved the [Play] button under the selected character in Character Selection.
 Various sound effect improvements.

notes.title: Stashgiving! Wed (Nov 23) -> Mon (Nov 28)
notes.content:
Join us for Stashgiving to celebrate Stash's first Thanksgiving weekend!
Wednesday, November 23rd  (~4pm EST) until Monday, November 28th (~11am EST):

+25% XP - Combat, Crafting, and Gathering XP

Double Party XP Bonus - Based on party size:

2: +40% xp / 3: +80% xp / 4: +120% xp / 5: +160% xp / 6: +220% xp


Double resource drops from nodes.

Pumpkin Pie: Delicious holiday food item that will randomly drop from all mob types. Max Health and Mana healing possible for level, and trains all stats!

Chat 2.0 - Revamped chat system with tons of new features (clickable links, emotes, and more)

Rolling Stone Inn - a social gathering place in Askagard with a magical hearth that provides health and mana regeneration.

Leaderboards - the debut of leaderboards that allow you to compete in many categories (level, crafting, gathering, and more) for all time, monthly, and weekly!

And a very special, 2 hour event during Stashgiving:

Saturday Night Stash
Saturday, November 26 from 8pm to 10pm EST.

The primary goal of this event is to get a lot of people online at the same time to get to know each other, make friends, invite people to clans, and meet people you can party with. We know this time doesn't work for people in every time zone, but no time would so we are going with a known popular time for this first experiment.

WE WILL DEFINITELY DO EVENTS IN THE FUTURE AT DIFFERENT DAYS/TIMES FOR PEOPLE OF ALL TIME ZONES! :)

For this first, experimental SNS, this is what we have planned:

Giant Riding Pokka - Just for attending the event you will receive this unique mount that is 300% speed.

Stash Development Roadmap - I will share the roadmap for upcoming development on Stash. What's coming next? What's coming over the next few weeks?

Developer Q&A - Ask questions and we will do our best to answer.

Meet Your Fellow Players - This is probably the most important thing about this event.

notes.title: Mobstravaganza Weekend - +25% XP, Pumpkin Pie, new Bosses, new Mobs!
notes.content:
MOBSTRAVAGANZA WEEKEND - 2016

November 4 (Fri) through November 8 (Mon) - Starting and ending at 4pm EDT


 +25% XP (combat, crafting, and gathering XP).

 Pumpkin Pie: Delicious holiday food item that will randomly drop from all mob types. Max Health and Mana healing possible for level, and trains all stats!

 1/2 xp debt from death and fleeing to encourage you to take some risks! (XP debt begins at level 10.)

 New Boss #1: Ruined Barracks (level 5-9 dungeon).

 New Boss #2: Forgotten Cellar (level 15-19 dungeon).

 Lieutenants, Elites, and Champions: These new mob ranks can spawn starting at level 5. The larger your party, the more chance 1 or more of these will spawn in your encounter. They are stronger, worth more XP, and have a higher chance to drop magic items. 

 Customized Mob Spawns: Dungeons and overland zones now have custom mob spawn lists, making dungeons more distinctive.


We want to test out all these new mob features and do something festive at the same time. 

Staff will be online throughout the event to chat with players, adventure with players, run contests and trivia challenges (study up on that lore!), and inspire craziness!

See you in game!
